blocks.text: Dil ki deewar teen tahon se bani hai. Pericardium ki andar wali tah, yani epicardium, dil ki deewar ki sab se bahar wali tah banati hai. Epicardium ke neeche dil ki deewar ki sab se moti tah myocardium hai, jo cardiac muscles (dil ke pathon) se bani hai. Myocardium ke neeche endocardium hai. Yeh epithelial cells ki sirf ek tah hai aur dil ke khanon (chambers) ki andar ki parat banati hai (Figure 11.1).

blocks.alt: Baen: dil apni shaffaf (see-through) pericardium ki thaili ke andar, deewar par ek chhota box. Darmiyan: box bara kar ke tahon (layers) mein: pericardium, jo fibrous pericardium aur serous pericardium se bana hai; serous ki parietal aur visceral tahein hain. Daen: dil ki deewar ka tukra: bahar parietal aur visceral pericardium, un ke beech pericardial fluid, phir muscle fibres ka mota myocardium aur andar endocardium.

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Visceral pericardium hi dil ki deewar ki bahari tah (epicardium) hai. Parietal aur visceral tahon ke beech pericardial fluid ragar (friction) kam karta hai.
